issues.problem: Act values 手紙を書きました, メールを送りました and プレゼントを送りました also accept へ for the recipient (友達へ手紙を書く), which cannot be listed as an alternative because the other acts (見せる, 貸す, 渡す, 教える) reject へ; a learner answering へ would be marked wrong.
issues.action: Replaced with お土産をあげました (gave a souvenir to), 花をあげました (gave flowers to), お茶を出しました (served tea to), which take only に.

issues.problem: Act value メールを送って accepts へ for the recipient, unlike the rest of the frame.
issues.action: Replaced with お茶を出して (serve tea to).

issues.problem: Act values 写真を送って and 手紙を出して accept へ for the recipient, unlike the rest of the frame.
issues.action: Replaced with お礼を言って (hasn't said thank you to) and 電話番号を教えて (hasn't given the phone number to).
